terms.comment: Vault-relative path of the schema note that declared the type or edge type. Importers may use it to group types into notes.
The type's template link: a wikilink, a markdown link or a vault-relative path.
The body of the schema note of a type declared with schema:, which is that type's template.
The type's or edge type's visualization mapping, serialized as JSON with sorted keys.
True when the type declares edges: outgoing edges of other types are reported. Unlike sh:closed it leaves frontmatter properties open.
True for an edge entry that allows any target type, which has no sh:class to mark it as an edge.
"list" for a property of kind list, which SHACL cannot distinguish from a text property with many values.
A non-scalar default value, such as a list, serialized as JSON. Scalar defaults use sh:defaultValue.
